neighbours.label: 'you' after a time, condition, or situation setup, introducing a possible or expected experience
fire: When the numbing medicine wears off, you may notice a dull ache around the treated area.
As the software installation progresses, you may encounter a warning about insufficient storage.
Keep a daily record of rainfall and you will see seasonal patterns emerge.
For particularly large spreadsheets, you may experience delays when sorting several columns.
If the mountain trail becomes icy, you may find the final climb unexpectedly difficult.
Once the orchestra begins the quieter movement, you will hear the flute more clearly.
After several rounds of the game, you may recognize which moves leave the king exposed.
In rooms with very dry air, you may feel a slight irritation in the throat.
